definitions.explanation: Each and every day; daily. Used to express something that happens or is done on a daily basis. Can function as both a noun and an adverb.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}しています→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
{毎日|まいにち}⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦ごはん→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べます→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Do you eat breakfast every day?

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きます→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: I wake up at the same time every day.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{三十|さんじゅっ}→三十：00984_sanjuu⟧⟦{分|ぷん}→分：00928_fun⟧⟦くらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I like to read for about thirty minutes before going to bed every night.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Going to work every day is tough, but on my days off I relax at home.

notes:
{毎日|まいにち} means "every day" — it can function as a noun or an adverb.

GRAMMAR:
As an adverb it takes no particle, and typically comes at the beginning of the sentence or just before the verb:
- {毎日|まいにち}⟦{勉強|べんきょう}する→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧ (study every day)

まい- SERIES (the prefix meaning "every, each"):
- {毎日|まいにち}: every day
- ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧: every morning
- ⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧: every night
- ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧: every week
- ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧: every month
- ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧: every year

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧: day by day, daily (more literary)
- {毎日|まいにち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦よう→よう：01114_you⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: almost every day — softer than {毎日|まいにち} on its own, used when something happens nearly, but not literally, every day
